answer: The strongest single control I know for this is Licensed museum curator register with museums council confirmation, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. The farm's edge dies on cost: each alias adds 104 POA of exposure, so 554 aliases carry 57616 POA of risk for one epoch's payout. One onyx of signal, one spiral of cost, one basalt of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
